name: Solenne NanoClima Spire Skin
description:
An almost weightless full-torso underlayer in Solenne's signature void-white, so fine it reads as a second skin under transparent or light-colored outwear. The nano-fiber weave is visibly iridescent at close range — faint blue-gold shift depending on light angle. Solenne's atelier mark is woven into the inner left hem in platinum thread, readable only by scanner or tactile inspection.

Designed for Spire-level clients whose environments move between climate-controlled towers, exposed skybridge transit, and pressurized event spaces. The layer maintains a 0.5-degree personal microclimate regardless of external conditions — imperceptible to others, absolute in effect.
functionality: Active microclimate regulation maintains personal temperature within 0.5°C of set-point via nano-fiber contraction and expansion. Interfaces with Spire BCI climate profiles for automated preference management. Moisture response is instantaneous — no perceptible sweat. Self-sealing hems conform to body changes including minor geneware expression shifts. Hand-wash only; Solenne atelier service recommended.
what_it_says: Comfort at this level is invisible and total — the effort is in never appearing to need anything.
story_hooks: The nano-fiber regulation system can be read as a passive environmental sensor — someone with the right equipment can reconstruct everywhere the wearer has been based on the layer's thermal memory log.
A Solenne insider is quietly selling irregular production units — cosmetically identical but missing the climate regulation core — to Tier 3 aspirants trying to fake Spire affiliation.
The atelier mark woven into the hem carries an encrypted ownership record; a recovered Solenne Skin found on a Shelf body suggests someone powerful lost something, or someone very dangerous took it.
